Name: Bright Indoor Nights
Author: moriAHIRU
Description:
[heading]Description

[size=3]Language: Japanese only
The in-game text is currently available in Japanese only.[/size][/heading]
Bright Indoor Nights adds purchasable indoor lighting to Robin's shop.
You can pay Robin 10,000g to install lighting in individual buildings, making them bright at night without placing additional furniture or lamps.
The lighting is applied only at night, so daytime indoor lighting remains unchanged.

[heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download and extract [b]Bright Indoor Nights[/b].[/*]
[*]Place the
[code]Bright Indoor Nights[/code]folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]No additional configuration is required.

[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Adds an [b]Indoor Lighting[/b] option to Robin's shop.[/*]
[*]Install lighting in individual buildings for [b]10,000g[/b] each.[/*]
[*]Lighting is applied only at night.[/*]
[*]Installed lighting is saved with your save file.[/*]
[*]Buildings that already have lighting installed are removed from the purchase list.[/*]
[*]Supports multiple buildings of the same type individually.[/*]
[*]Supports the Greenhouse once it has been repaired.[/*]
[*]Supports vanilla farm buildings and selected Stardew Valley Expanded buildings.[/*]
[*]Robin gives you a short message after installing the lighting.[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[/list]Stardew Valley Expanded is only required if you want to use the lighting option for SVE buildings supported by this mod.
No additional configuration is required.

[heading]Shoutouts[/heading]
Thanks to the Stardew Valley and SMAPI communities for the tools, documentation, and inspiration that made this mod possible.
Special thanks to the creators of Stardew Valley Expanded for their amazing work and for creating such wonderful additional locations and buildings.
